mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS batch_id, b.batch_code, b.batch_name, b.batch_status, b.species_name, b.image_count, b.identified_count, b.reviewed_count, b.need_review_count, b.final_species_name, b.avg_similarity, b.quality_level, b.quality_score, b.evaluation_summary FROM herb_batch b LEFT JOIN herb_collection_task t ON t.id = b.task_id AND t.is_deleted = 0 WHERE b.id = #{batchId} AND b.is_deleted = 0 AND ( #{dataScopeAll} = TRUE OR b.created_by = #{currentUserId} OR t.collector_id = #{currentUserId} OR t.created_by = #{currentUserId} ) LIMIT 1

SELECT bi.image_id, bi.image_role, r.final_species_name, r.final_confidence, r.need_review, r.review_status, r.result_source, r.match_result, r.suggestion FROM herb_batch_image bi INNER JOIN herb_batch b ON b.id = bi.batch_id AND b.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN herb_collection_task t ON t.id = b.task_id AND t.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN herb_image i ON i.id = bi.image_id AND i.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN herb_identification_result r ON r.id = COALESCE( bi.identification_result_id, ( SELECT latest.id FROM herb_identification_result latest WHERE latest.image_id = bi.image_id AND latest.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY latest.identify_time DESC, latest.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) ) AND r.is_deleted = 0 WHERE bi.batch_id = #{batchId} AND bi.is_deleted = 0 AND bi.bind_status = 'bound' AND ( #{dataScopeAll} = TRUE OR b.created_by = #{currentUserId} OR t.collector_id = #{currentUserId} OR t.created_by = #{currentUserId} ) ORDER BY bi.is_primary DESC, bi.sort_order ASC, bi.created_at ASC
